# BuiltbyGSV

> BuiltbyGSV is a Product & AI Engineering Studio.
> It builds websites, custom business software, AI features and workflow automation for clients in
> Karaikal, Thanjavur and Bengaluru, and remotely across India. It is a remote studio with no walk-in
> office and no Google Business Profile listing.

Contact: admin@builtbygsv.in | +91-74488-65095 | https://www.builtbygsv.in/contact

## Careers
- [Software Engineer Intern](https://www.builtbygsv.in/careers/software-engineer-intern): 6 months internship. Contribute to application features, APIs and internal tools, with attention to how the whole system works. Apply to admin@builtbygsv.in.
- [Web Developer Intern](https://www.builtbygsv.in/careers/web-developer-intern): 6 months internship. Contribute to responsive websites and web interfaces where clear design and reliable implementation matter. Apply to admin@builtbygsv.in.

## Services
- [Product Engineering](https://www.builtbygsv.in/services/web-development): We design and engineer websites, web applications and customer-facing platforms around the people using them.
- [Software Engineering](https://www.builtbygsv.in/services/custom-software-development): We build custom applications, dashboards and backend systems around your business workflows.
- [AI Engineering](https://www.builtbygsv.in/services/ai-solutions): We build AI assistants, retrieval-based search and model integrations for defined business tasks.
- [Automation & Integrations](https://www.builtbygsv.in/services/automation): We connect existing tools with workflows that reduce repeated data entry and manual follow-up.

## Service areas
- [AI Automation Agency in Karaikal | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/ai-automation-agency-karaikal): BuiltbyGSV builds AI and automation systems for Karaikal businesses: WhatsApp and form enquiry routing, invoice and document extraction, appointment reminders, and automatic daily reporting. Each build starts as one measured workflow with a fixed cost ceiling and a human fallback, so it can be judged on hours saved rather than on the technology used.
- [Ecommerce Website Development in Karaikal | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/ecommerce-website-development-karaikal): BuiltbyGSV builds online stores for Karaikal retailers and producers: product catalogue, UPI and card checkout, delivery-zone and shipping rules, WhatsApp ordering, and stock that stays in step with the shop counter. Stores are built mobile-first because almost all local traffic arrives on a phone over mobile data.
- [SEO Services in Karaikal | Local Search | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/seo-services-karaikal): BuiltbyGSV does technical and local SEO for Karaikal businesses: fixing crawl and indexing problems, building one page per real search intent, adding correct structured data, and setting up Google Business Profile and citations. No agency can guarantee a number-one ranking, and any that does is selling something Google does not sell.
- [Custom Software Development in Karaikal | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/custom-software-development-karaikal): BuiltbyGSV builds custom business software for Karaikal companies: billing and invoicing, appointment and booking systems, inventory and stock control, staff and attendance tools, and customer portals. Scope starts from the workflow your team already runs, and you own the source code and the data at the end.
- [Clinic & Hospital Website Development in Karaikal | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/clinic-website-development-karaikal): We design clinic websites and appointment workflows for Karaikal around service discovery, booking and contact. We scope integrations, access controls and deployment requirements before development. The Thaai Clinic concept prototype explores the patient experience; it is not evidence of a production healthcare deployment.
- [AI Automation Agency in Thanjavur (Tanjore) | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/ai-automation-agency-thanjavur): BuiltbyGSV builds AI and automation systems for Thanjavur and Tanjore businesses: order and enquiry routing, purchase and dispatch document extraction, production and stock reporting, and admission or appointment follow-up. Projects start as a single measured workflow with a fixed cost ceiling and a human review step.
- [Custom Software Development in Thanjavur (Tanjore) | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/custom-software-development-thanjavur): BuiltbyGSV builds custom business software for Thanjavur and Tanjore organisations: billing and GST invoicing, inventory and dispatch tracking, admission and student systems, hospital and appointment tools, and dealer or customer portals. The build starts from your existing process, and source code, database and hosting are handed over to you.
- [Ecommerce Website Development in Thanjavur | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/ecommerce-website-development-thanjavur): BuiltbyGSV builds online stores for Thanjavur and Tanjore businesses, including handicraft, textile, food and trade catalogues. Builds cover product catalogue, UPI and card checkout, pan-India and international shipping rules, WhatsApp ordering, and stock synchronised with your existing billing system.
- [MVP Development Company in Bengaluru | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/mvp-development-company-bengaluru): BuiltbyGSV builds MVPs for Bengaluru founders and early teams: a shippable first release covering authentication, payments, the core workflow and analytics, typically in six to ten weeks. The build targets one validated user journey and is written to be extended by your own team rather than rewritten after the raise.
- [SaaS Development Company in Bengaluru | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/saas-development-company-bengaluru): BuiltbyGSV builds and extends SaaS products for Bengaluru teams: multi-tenant data architecture, subscription and usage billing, role-based permissions, onboarding flows, admin tooling and usage analytics. The work is done in React, TypeScript, Node and Postgres, with the operational pieces treated as core scope rather than as later additions.
- [AI Automation Agency in Bengaluru | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/ai-automation-agency-bengaluru): BuiltbyGSV builds production AI systems for Bengaluru teams: retrieval assistants over internal data, document and invoice extraction, agent workflows, and AI features inside existing products. Every build includes an evaluation set, guardrails, a per-tenant cost ceiling and a defined human fallback.

## Reference
- [Website & Software Development Pricing in India | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/pricing): A starter business website in India typically costs INR 18,000 to 45,000, a growth website with proper service pages and SEO foundations INR 60,000 to 1,60,000, an online store INR 85,000 to 2,50,000, and custom software from INR 1,50,000 upward. Scope, integrations and content ownership move the price far more than the technology used.
- [Frequently Asked Questions | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/faq): BuiltbyGSV is a Product & AI Engineering Studio working with clients in Karaikal, Thanjavur, Bengaluru and remotely across India. Projects are fee-based with agreed scope, clients own the source code and accounts at handover, and the first conversation and scoping discussion are free.
- [Freelancer vs Web Development Agency: How to Choose | BuiltbyGSV](https://www.builtbygsv.in/compare/freelance-developer-vs-web-development-agency): A freelance developer usually costs least and suits small, well-defined builds, but carries continuity risk. An agency costs most and suits large multi-workstream projects needing guaranteed cover. A small studio sits between: one accountable technical owner, agency-level process, but limited parallel capacity. Match the choice to project size and how much continuity risk you can absorb.

## Case studies
- [S4SkillUp](https://www.builtbygsv.in/projects/s4skillup): S4SkillUp is a responsive career-planning and job-preparation platform for students, first-job seekers and career switchers in India. It brings role exploration, project planning, resume editing, job discovery, application tracking and interview practice into a connected workspace. The product is live at s4skillup.com, with ongoing development and personal drafts saved on the device.
- [KAMAYUU](https://www.builtbygsv.in/projects/kamayuu-card-game): Players can practice solo or create private multiplayer tables. The interface includes onboarding, player identity, tutorials, settings, score tracking, and table interactions, with card art, sound, and haptic feedback. Online play requires the configured backend.
- [STRIATUM 4.0](https://www.builtbygsv.in/projects/striatum-4-symposium-platform): The site serves symposium delegates and organizers. Delegates can browse events, apply for access, select events, and submit payment proof. Organizers have registration-management screens. Event data and pricing rules are maintained in the repository.
- [Reelcut](https://www.builtbygsv.in/projects/reelcut-ai-video-editor): Reelcut is being built for creators, colleges and small teams who record more video than they have time to edit. A creator uploads a long recording and the editor suggests cuts: removing silences and filler, generating word-timed captions, and reframing horizontal footage into vertical formats. Every suggestion stays editable on a timeline before export.
- [Karaikal One](https://www.builtbygsv.in/projects/karaikal-one): Karaikal One is designed for residents of Karaikal and nearby areas. It combines bus and train schedule browsing, local provider discovery, community help requests, lost-and-found posts and volunteer information. The interface supports English, Tamil and common Tanglish queries, and is built to work as a web app, installable PWA and future Capacitor-based Android application.
- [TEMPO](https://www.builtbygsv.in/projects/tempo-word-game): Players arrange four scrambled tiles into answer slots and submit an accepted word. The interface shows how many possible solutions remain, without displaying an unformed answer. It supports touch and keyboard input. Best score is stored on the device and is not synchronized.
- [GSV OS](https://www.builtbygsv.in/projects/gsv-os-studio-operations): GSV OS is a private operating tool for BuiltbyGSV. It tracks work from lead through delivery and ongoing maintenance, with proposal versioning, requirements history, change-request handling, invoices, and a structured knowledge store. Optional AI can suggest actions, while the core workflows are designed to work without an AI provider.
- [Thaai Clinic](https://www.builtbygsv.in/projects/thaai-clinic-website): Thaai Clinic is a React + TypeScript healthcare app that simulates a full patient journey in a polished mobile interface. It includes onboarding, appointment booking, appointment tracking, medical record management, health education content, clinic details, and instant contact options through call and WhatsApp.
